# AstroMeters

> AstroMeters designs and manufactures open-source precision hardware for astronomy: AllSky cameras, telescope focusers, sky quality and cloud sensors, and mount controllers. Products are assembled and tested in-house. Documentation, firmware and hardware designs are openly available.

- Website: {{ site.url }}
- Contact: info@astrometers.eu (sales, quotes, custom development)
- Source code: https://github.com/AstroMeters
- Software: [Caelum](https://caelum.astrometers.eu) – open-source capture engine for all-sky cameras, default software of the AMASC01 camera
- Prices are in EUR; most products are ordered by e-mail ("Get offer").
